kept.heading: CONSUMER TRUST AROUND BLACK FRIDAY DEALS IS DOWN (4 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Black Friday has stretched into a month of discounts, which removed the urgency that once made a 30% off banner work. Nearly three-quarters of shoppers now call the event more hype than genuine savings, even at brands whose deals match last year's. More sale days spread the same demand thinner, but brands say opting out is not an option. The ones adapting rotate individual products through deals to rebuild momentum or move the promo budget into a brand campaign instead.

kept.heading: AI IS MOVING WAY TOO FAST (9 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: AI capabilities are advancing faster than society can adapt. While human expertise still plays a critical role in directing AI today, that advantage may not last as models develop stronger reasoning and research abilities. The bigger concern is that AI labs are racing toward superintelligence without clear plans to control it or align it with human interests. Political systems may struggle to keep pace with the technology's rapid evolution.

kept.heading: WIN REPORT: THE THREE WORDS WE ADDED TO A PRODUCT PAGE THAT INCREASED CONVERSIONS BY 12% (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Adding context to customer review counts can make social proof more persuasive and increase product conversions. DiamondBack Covers tested replacing an unlabeled review count with the phrase “2,863 Real-World Reviews” next to its 4.9-star rating. The change increased conversions by 12%. Research showed that 16% of skeptical buyers cited positive reviews and research as a reason they ultimately purchased. Clearly identifying reviews as real customer experiences can help reduce purchase hesitation.

kept.heading: BEHIND GOOD CONTENT: AEO EXPERT KEVIN WHITE (34 MINUTE PODCAST)
kept.blurb: This podcast features Kevin White sharing how brands can improve their visibility in AI search. He explains the 3 stages of AEO - being cited, mentioned, and recommended - then breaks down Scrunch's strategy for increasing its AI mention rate from 15% to 40% in 2 months. The playbook focuses on updating existing content, earning placements on trusted third-party sites, and publishing targeted FAQs. He also explains why AEO requires ongoing updates, as citations typically decay within 6-8 weeks.

kept.heading: WHAT MARKETERS SHOULD BUILD NEXT WITH AI (25 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: This guide teaches how to become AI builders by creating custom skills and agents instead of relying on basic AI prompts. It shares 30 ideas for automating internal workflows and creating interactive tools for audiences. Examples include building brand voice checkers, customer benchmark tools, and reusable AI skills. It also explains how MCPs connect these builds to tools like Claude and ChatGPT, with a walkthrough using Lovable.

kept.heading: AI SHOPPING AGENTS BOUGHT A FAKE DEAL 37% OF THE TIME – CLAUDE OPUS NEVER DID (4 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: AI shopping agents often prioritize ratings and low prices over signs of fraudulent listings, creating an opportunity for misleading products to win recommendations. In a test of 9 AI models across 6,156 shopping trips, 8 models bought an obviously fake deal 37% of the time, even when they recognized suspicious pricing. Listing order also mattered: agents bought the fake 65% of the time when it appeared first, compared with 34% elsewhere. When asked to find the best value, agents chose the fake 53% of the time, suggesting that AI shopping recommendations can be vulnerable to misleading reviews, pricing, and product positioning.

kept.heading: HOLIDAYS HAPPEN ON TIKTOK (7 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: TikTok's holiday guide on seasonal trends, creator recommendations, and shopping content. This year's emerging trends include Whimsy Christmas décor, DIY gifts, nostalgic decorations, and cozy holiday experiences. Posts about stocking stuffers are up almost 200%, while beauty advent calendar posts have grown nearly 640%, highlighting demand for smaller, giftable products. Holiday searches are also surging, including a more than 40x increase in searches for Christmas decorations and a 31x increase for Christmas lists. Brands can tap into these trends through creator partnerships, shoppable content, and timely products that reflect what consumers are already searching for and discussing.

kept.heading: HOW MANY PRODUCTS DOES AN ECOMMERCE CATEGORY PAGE NEED? (7 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Across 25,000+ Shopify category pages, most of the gain in Google visibility came from the first 16 products, with much smaller gains after that. The cutoff moved with search demand, since niche categories stopped improving at 9-16 products while mid-volume ones kept climbing until 33-64. Homepage links mattered more as categories grew, since linked ones ranked 15-30 points higher at every size and kept climbing after unlinked ones stalled at 9-16 products. Empty categories are better merged or redirected, since nearly half still appeared in search with nothing on the page.

kept.heading: HOW BLACK FRIDAY CHANGES AI SHOPPING ANSWERS (21 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Black Friday changes which pages AI shopping answers cite, not which brands they name. Publisher best-of lists grew to 65-94% of Black Friday citations in toys and superstores, with most of the gain in the final 10 days. Brand websites gained none of that share, and most of it went to pages published that season rather than older ones refreshed with the new year. On ChatGPT's product tiles, about 4 in 10 products got cheaper that week, but the most-reviewed product came first more often than the cheapest.

kept.heading: WALMART TEAMS UP WITH META TO BRING BLACK FRIDAY DEALS TO AI AGENT MUSE (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Walmart is letting outside AI agents shop for its customers, the opposite of Amazon's move to block third-party agents from making purchases.
